title: India, US have agree on preferential market access for Indian goods in America: Piyush Goyal
summary: India and the US finalised the framework for the first phase of the bilateral trade agreement in February.
llm_summary: India and the United States have struck a deal to give Indian products preferential access to U.S. markets, a move announced by trade minister Piyush Goyal. The agreement, which wraps up the first‑phase framework of a broader bilateral trade pact finalized in February, is expected
